# Donchie

> Donchie is a licensed Home Health Aide (HHA) business based in Upland, California, providing in-home bathing assistance, bedbound (in-bed) bathing, and personal care for seniors across the Inland Empire.

## Key facts

- Business: Donchie — in-home Home Health Aide (HHA) care
- Caregivers: Dona and Archie, licensed Home Health Aides
- Credential: Certified Home Health Aide, California Department of Public Health (CDPH), Certificate #00266808
- Based in: Upland, CA
- Phone (call or text): 626-771-7471
- Email: archibon.lamaria1967@gmail.com
- Website: https://donchie.com/

## Services

- Bathing Assistance: gentle, respectful help with bathing and hygiene that preserves dignity and comfort.
- Bedbound Bathing Assistance: specialized in-bed bathing care for clients with limited mobility.
- Personal Care Services: day-to-day support with grooming, dressing, and personal needs so clients can stay comfortable at home.

## Service area

Upland, Rancho Cucamonga, Ontario, Fontana, Rialto, San Bernardino, Chino, Chino Hills, Pomona, Claremont, Covina, Riverside, and Corona, California (Inland Empire and surrounding areas).
